name: orbitin
description: Interactive orbital mechanics and satellite visualization in the browser: a 3D Earth, a 2D ground-track map and a published satellite catalogue.
author: Lauri Varjola

scripts.build:worker: npm run build:worker:orbitin && npm run build:worker:orbitin-dev && npm run build:worker:catalogue && npm run build:worker:catalogue-fixture && npm run build:worker:catalogue-monitor && node scripts/deployment/checkWorkerBundles.mjs
scripts.deploy:orbitin: node scripts/deployment/deployGuard.mjs orbitin && npm run build && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.orbitin.jsonc
scripts.deploy:orbitin-dev: node scripts/deployment/deployGuard.mjs orbitin-dev && npm run build:development && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.orbitin-dev.jsonc
scripts.deploy:catalogue: node scripts/deployment/deployGuard.mjs orbitin-catalogue && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.catalogue.jsonc
scripts.deploy:catalogue-fixture: node scripts/deployment/deployGuard.mjs orbitin-catalogue-fixture && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.catalogue-fixture.jsonc
scripts.deploy:catalogue-monitor: node scripts/deployment/deployGuard.mjs orbitin-catalogue-monitor && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.catalogue-monitor.jsonc
scripts.build:development: tsc && vite build --mode development && node scripts/build/checkMeasurementHarnessExcluded.mjs dist
